name: Everyday Decoded
tagline: The hidden side of the things you use every day.

audience.units: US first (°F, miles, mph, gallons, inches); metric in brackets only if useful

fb.note: Page ID and token are read from the laptop's .env at runtime. Never store them in this file or in git.

voice.director_notes: Friendly American-English expert for a US social video about how everyday things work. Curious, warm, knowledgeable tone; about 165-175 words per minute. Short sentences, continuous narration, a small pause right before the twist fact. Lively intonation, never monotone or salesy.

render_defaults.note: Laptop #2 (RTX 3050, ~4 GB VRAM): one Blender GPU process at a time (PLAN 7b). Samples/engine are set by the benchmark.

captions.note: Needs a per-Page highlight colour option in pipeline/overlay_v2.py (today: red). Shared change, not done here.

fonts.caption: PLACEHOLDER: Montserrat ExtraBold (open licence, to be committed in assets/fonts/)
fonts.note: Per PLAN 7b font resolver: open-licence fonts committed in the repo; Avenir Next / DIN are Mac-only and stay WJH-only.

posting.note: Times are US Eastern wall-clock; the scheduler converts with a tz database (EST/EDT shift), never a fixed MYT offset.

ramp_up.then: 3/day -> 5/day after the render benchmark and week-1 insights
